SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

3. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

4. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

5. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

6. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

7. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

9. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
